data.summary: The pod startup was delayed primarily by the application downloading a 500 MB model file during initialisation. This model download process accounted for 53.4 seconds of the total 61.0-second startup time. The remaining phases, including scheduling and image pulling, were within expected performance bounds.

findings.statement: The model.download span took 53.369 seconds to complete, which is the dominant factor in the 61.0-second total startup time.
The model download involved transferring 524,288,000 bytes (approximately 500 MB) from the internal model hub.
The image pull phase was efficient, taking only 4.184 seconds for a 53 MB image.

ruled_out.reason: The image pull duration was only 4.184 seconds for a 53 MB image, which is not the cause of the 61-second startup delay.
Scheduling took only 1.0 second, indicating no significant delay in pod placement or resource allocation.

recommendations.rationale: The application currently downloads the 500 MB model on every cold start, which is the primary bottleneck.

recommendations.action: Use an InitContainer to fetch model weights
recommendations.rationale: Moving the model download to an InitContainer can separate the infrastructure-level data fetching from the application logic, potentially allowing for better caching strategies.
